description: Canonical animation-trigger facet (schema v3). This is intentionally separate from visual vibe, animation technique, technology and source. An entry may have several triggers, but every trigger must be evidenced by the component's behaviours, source or implementation.

triggers.label: On mount
triggers.description: Plays once when it enters the DOM.

triggers.label: Hover
triggers.description: Responds while the pointer rests over the element.

triggers.label: Cursor-reactive
triggers.description: Follows or reacts to pointer position.

triggers.label: Click / tap
triggers.description: Fires on a deliberate click or tap.

triggers.label: Scroll position
triggers.description: Progress or content is driven by scroll position.

triggers.label: Viewport entry
triggers.description: Triggers when the element enters the viewport.

triggers.label: Gesture
triggers.description: Pinch, wheel, swipe or another multi-input gesture.

triggers.label: Route transition
triggers.description: Runs when navigating between views or pages.

triggers.label: Static
triggers.description: No animation trigger; informational or resting UI.
